title: French Mushroom Terrine
description: A rich and earthy French terrine made with sautéed mushrooms and served as a side dish. Perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Such as button, cremini, and shiitake

ingredients.name: Energizing Greens
ingredients.notes: Add a boost of energy to your dish.

ingredients.name: Terrine Meat
ingredients.notes: Choose a lean meat, such as chicken or turkey.

instructions: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper to the mushrooms and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cubed baguette, crumbled terrine meat, and chopped energizing greens.
Layer the mushroom mixture and meat mixture in a terrine dish, ending with a layer of mushrooms on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the terrine is heated through.
